items.title: Gutierrez runs for 5 TDs, Navy blows 28-point lead before recovering to edge Temple 42-35
items.description: (AP) — Jackson Gutierrez rushed for a career-high five touchdowns including the game-winner with 1:14 remaining after Navy blew a 28-point lead to pull out a 42-35 victory over Temple on Saturday,After a Navy fake punt failed, Jaxon Smolik threw a 25-yard touchdown pass to tie the game with 5 1/2 minutes to go. The Midshipmen (3-6, 2-4 American) responded with a nine-play, 75-yard drive on the ground with Gutierrez's tackle-breaking 39-yard run leading to his own clinching 4-yard score.

items.title: Penn State starts strong, holds on to beat Washington 28-25
items.author: JOSH KIRSHENBAUM
items.description: SEATTLE (AP) — Penn State got good news on the injury front for its wide receiver room, and the Nittany Lions made the most of it early before holding on late for a 28-25 win over Washington at Husky Stadium on Saturday.Quarterback Rocco Becht went 16-for-27 for 240 yards and threw first-half touchdowns to Chase Sowell and Zay Robinson, both of whom were listed as questionable on the pregame injury report but ended up being good to play.
